evidence.quoted_text: raise ReconcileRefused("repository number cap exceeded; operator partition required")
evidence.reason: Line 439 raises a repository-wide ceiling failure but tells the operator to partition, which cannot help: `freeze_source` stores the repository ceiling and `number_page` rejects any source whose ceiling exceeds `MAX_REPOSITORY_NUMBER` (line 450), so every interval partition would fail before its first page. This is a minor error-message defect: keep the safety cap but describe the repository-wide limit instead of suggesting an impossible interval partition.
